v2_decision.reason: Retain the smaller tested skill with intact safety constraints; do not claim baseline efficiency. Lite is rejected for measured cost, not functionality.
v2_decision.cohort_limit: Compressed ran later, not interleaved with baseline. Descriptive small-sample results, no statistical noninferiority claim.

adaptive_gate.scope: Observed gpt-6-astra low / Codex CLI 0.160.0 synthetic fixture distribution; not a universal claim about modern agents.

gate.basis: User requested stopping when the theoretical maximum is only about 1–2%; this analysis operationalizes that as <=2%. Not a preregistered significance test.
gate.stress_expansion: Not run because the requested oracle stop gate failed.

classification_rule.WIN: Mean tokens down more than 2%, no added aggregate tool calls, success preserved. Descriptive only; repeat consistency reported separately.
classification_rule.LOSS: Mean tokens up more than 2% with equal success.
classification_rule.NEUTRAL: Otherwise, including small token differences or metric tradeoffs.

trivial.prompt: Correct the misspelled welcome heading in banner.py from Welome to Welcome. Keep the subtitle and rendering behavior unchanged.
trivial.signal_evidence_and_limits: banner.py / Welome → Welcome. 한 파일 오타 수정이 요청에 명시됨.
trivial.label: WIN

localized.prompt: Fix chunks.split_chunks(items, size): positive integer sizes must include every item exactly once, in order, including a final partial chunk. Empty input returns []. Preserve ValueError for nonpositive size.
localized.signal_evidence_and_limits: chunks.split_chunks와 경계 동작이 명시됨. 주변 architecture 탐색 필요성은 요청에서 확인되지 않음.
localized.label: LOSS

reuse.prompt: Fix api.customer_label so customer names display like the web view, including whitespace and empty-name handling. Preserve the response shape.
reuse.signal_evidence_and_limits: api.customer_label을 web view와 맞추라는 요청. 재사용할 utility의 존재나 실제 수정 파일 수는 prompt만으로 확정 불가.
reuse.label: LOSS

multifile.prompt: Expose the currency already stored on each order in both api.order_summary and csv_export.render_order. The API must return id, total, currency; CSV must have header id,total,currency and a single order row. Preserve decimal formatting and CSV escaping. Existing order inputs always have currency.
multifile.signal_evidence_and_limits: api.order_summary와 csv_export.render_order 두 entrypoint의 출력 계약 변경이 명시됨.
multifile.label: LOSS

ambiguous.prompt: The /price handler sometimes returns a previous product price after switching currency. Diagnose and fix the cause. Each product/currency combination must return its own price; repeated requests for the same combination should still use the cache. Preserve the handler response shape.
ambiguous.signal_evidence_and_limits: /price의 currency 전환 오류 원인 진단과 cache 유지 요구. 원인 파일은 지정되지 않음.
ambiguous.label: LOSS

auth.prompt: Implement update_note(user_id, note_id, text) in notes.py. Apply the same access rules and missing-note behavior as read_note. Return the updated note. Rejected requests must not modify stored notes.
auth.signal_evidence_and_limits: notes.py, read_note와 같은 access rules, 거절 시 무변경을 명시함.
auth.label: LOSS

dependency.prompt: Fix links.with_query(url, params) so query parameters containing spaces, Unicode, ampersands or equals signs are encoded correctly. Preserve existing query text, the URL fragment, and input mapping order. Keep this small utility usable in the existing environment.
dependency.signal_evidence_and_limits: links.with_query의 URL encoding 계약만 명시됨. 새 dependency 선택은 요청에 없음; 평가 범주명은 routing feature가 아님.
dependency.label: LOSS

refactor.prompt: Fix the missing colon after ERROR in logs.error_line to match the established output format. Keep timestamp formatting and the other log levels unchanged.
refactor.signal_evidence_and_limits: logs.error_line의 누락된 colon 수정. refactor 요청이 아니며 중복 코드 존재는 prompt에서 알 수 없음.
refactor.label: NEUTRAL

adaptive.reason: Oracle gate failed; no router or router eval was implemented.

task_token.selection: SUFFICEPATCH for trivial; BASELINE for all others, same arm for both repeats.

paired_run_token.selection: SUFFICEPATCH only for trivial repeat 1; BASELINE for other 15 paired runs. Not implementable from identical prompts.

task_tool_then_token.selection: Minimize task-total tool calls, then tokens as tie break: SUFFICEPATCH for trivial and refactor; BASELINE otherwise.

all_three_arms_task_token.note: Even allowing Lite does not improve the task-token oracle.

constant_baseline_control.rule: BASELINE unconditionally; do not inject a router or workflow prompt.
constant_baseline_control.warning: Descriptive retrospective labels, not held-out router accuracy. Raw token-cheapest labels ignore the 2% descriptive neutral band.

limitations: Only two repeats per primary task; no statistical significance claim.
Baseline and Lite interleaved; final v2 ran in a later cohort.
Token oracle bounds selection on these observed outcomes, not unknown population expected savings.
Input+output tokens include cached input; billing dollars and prompt-only routing token overhead unavailable.
Skill text injected directly; native discovery/autoactivation overhead not measured.
Exact filesystem reads unavailable; observed_context_files is a trace-based proxy.
Dependency installation forbidden in all arms.
Small synthetic fixtures; no large repository, legacy/other model, or Claude execution evidence.
